DeterminationBasis: Existing T16 controls may preserve claim scope, profile identity, requirements-matrix completeness, status evidence or determination basis, but none directly requires the conformance determination itself to remain traceable to both the specific requirements matrix and the test evidence supporting that determination. CONF-012 therefore requires a distinct determination-traceability test.

T13-002 directly establishes that a later successor result remains separate and that the earlier FAIL remains preserved, with failure if the later PASS rewrites the predecessor FAIL. This directly covers the prohibition on deleting a failed conformance result merely because a later successor test passed. No additional test definition is required.
